# kubesense_azure_subscription (Resource)

A Azure subscription integration. KubeSense checks the credentials when the integration is created and refuses ones that fail or belong to another account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kubesense_azure_subscription" "prod" {
  subscription_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  tenant_id       = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  client_id       = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
  client_secret   = var.azure_client_secret
  region          = "eastus"
}

variable "azure_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subscription_id` (String) Subscription GUID. Changing it creates a new integration.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether collection runs. false pauses it and keeps credentials and settings.
- `client_id` (String) Application (client) id of an app with Reader on the subscription.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret value. Write-only on the server, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, and it is not set on import.
- `region` (String) Default region, e.g. eastus.
- `resource_types` (Attributes Map) Resource types to collect, keyed by resource type (see Settings → Integrations for the names). When set, Terraform owns collection: types enabled in the UI but not listed here are switched off on the next apply. When omitted, collection is left to the UI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_types))
- `tenant_id` (String) Directory (tenant) id.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the UI: the account name the credentials resolved to.
- `id` (String) Integration id (the API's kuid).
- `status` (String) pending, healthy, error, paused or deleting.

<a id="nestedatt--resource_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_types`

Required:

- `collect` (Boolean) Collect inventory.
- `metric_enabled` (Boolean) Collect metrics.

Optional:

- `metric_extras` (Set of String) Extra metric names beyond the tier.
- `metric_tier` (String) core (the default) or expanded.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is the integration's kuid, shown in Settings → Integrations. The
# client secret is not imported; set it in the configuration.
terraform import kubesense_azure_subscription.prod 4b8d2f6a-1c3e-4a5b-9d7f-0e2c4a6b8d13
```
